description: A timestamp said the way a reader says it, with the exact one underneath. The relative label is never the only copy of the fact: `dateTime` carries the machine-readable instant and `title` the full local date, so "2 hours ago" is hoverable and parseable rather than the only thing on the page.

props.name: value
props.description: ISO string, epoch milliseconds, or a Date.

props.name: mode
props.description: `auto` (default) reads relative under a week and absolute after, which is what a notification list, a feed and a comment thread all want.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP-47 tag. Omit to follow the browser.

example:
<Stack gap={1}>
  {/* auto: relative while it is recent, the full date once it is not. */}
  <Time value={EDITED} />
  <Time value={JOINED} />
</Stack>
